_comment: Machine-readable privacy posture record. Canonical doc: docs/PRIVACY_POSTURE.md (two-tier model, ruled 2026-07-26). The Godot build persists LIVE player choices in user://config.cfg; this file records the shipped defaults plus legacy Python-era values for provenance. Formerly a stray artifact of the retired Python build's PrivacyManager (single-quoted pseudo-JSON); rewritten as valid JSON when the posture was ruled.

tier1_identity._comment: Global leaderboard: shares player name + lab name + score. EXPLICIT opt-in at first score submission (or the Settings toggle); one gracious empty-name reminder ever; both choices remembered locally and reversible in Settings.
tier1_identity.consent_point: first score submission (game-over prompt) or Settings toggle
tier1_identity.reminder_policy: one reminder ever for anonymous players, then silent

tier2_anonymous_telemetry._comment: Launch ping (#799): random install UUIDv4 + game version + OS + first_launch ONLY; never machine-derived; payload whitelist pinned by godot/tests/unit/test_update_check.gd. Decoupled from tier 1 (approved by Pip 2026-07-26): only its own toggle gates it.
tier2_anonymous_telemetry.settings_toggle: Anonymous launch ping (counts installs; no personal data)

legacy_python_era._comment: Historical keys from the retired Python build, preserved unchanged for provenance; unread by the Godot build. opt_in_leaderboard maps to the tier-1 identity opt-in (defaults still agree: off until consented).
